title: Fixed Cutaway Housing and Bored Ball Valve
description: One complete newly authored fixed cutaway ball-valve-inspired display. Two opposite full open annular connectors and raised seats flank an entire spherical closure with a real straight through-bore. A thick continuous three-quarter shell remains around the ball; its deliberately absent upper-side quadrant and finite cut walls expose the spherical body rather than hiding it behind a solid casing. The ball has a complete upright stem, whole upper neck collar and full lateral lever with thick grip. Two low finite connector supports attach the whole assembly to one grounded display bed. Not the old bulbous inline exterior with its internals absent, nor a thin wafer with a flat tilted disc: the new whole relation is a deep bored sphere inside a sectioned body and two annular end seats. All numeric geometry new, no old visible mesh imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z-up and full horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin; one whole static model zero scenes. Fixed simplified teaching-art appearance only, not a manufactured cross-section or exact valve design. No validated seat contact, seal, pressure, fluid continuity, flow, lever movement, rotation, torque, working thread, installation compatibility, actuation, engineering or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
